heroHeadline: Day 679: May 2026 Confirmed as Deadliest Month of the Year in Sinaloa — 135+ Violent Deaths; Aguaruto Prison Riot Kills 7; Joaquín Guzmán López June Hearing Cancelled, Rescheduled to August 31
heroSubtitle: 679 days of cartel civil war — June 2, 2026: Proceso and Milenio confirm May 2026 was Sinaloa's deadliest month of the year: 135+ violent deaths (Proceso) / 123 intentional homicides (Milenio), including 7 femicides and ~25 bodies from clandestine graves — reversing the March decline and averaging ~4 deaths/day. A May 31 riot in Aguaruto prison (Culiacán's main state penitentiary) killed 7 inmates in Module 7, demonstrating faction violence has penetrated the prison system. In Chicago (NDIL), Joaquín Guzmán López's June 1 in-person status hearing was cancelled and rescheduled to August 31, 2026 before Judge Sharon Johnson Coleman — consolidating the Sinaloa summer sentencing calendar: El Mayo EDNY July 20, Ovidio NDIL July 27, Joaquín NDIL Aug 31, Mérida SDNY Aug 4. El Chinacate at Altiplano (~25 days remaining on US extradition deadline ~July 27). 3 of 10 SDNY-indicted officials in Brooklyn MDC (Mérida, Díaz Vega, Inzunza Cazárez); 3 fugitives non-compliant (Contreras Núñez, Dionisio Hipólito, Valenzuela Millán). CJNG-Chapitos alliance fully collapsed; BC open conflict active. La Mayiza ~90% territorial control; 13,300+ federal troops under interim Governor Bonilla Valverde. Running toll: ~2,560+ homicides (Noroeste updated) / 3,000+ (WSJ) since September 9, 2024; ~5,800 disappearances (NGO Sabuesos Unidas AC).
